bundle.shortDescription: Hybrid compressor GUI (LZ77 + rANS + dict codec)
bundle.longDescription: NexusRAR is the desktop GUI for NexusCompress, a hybrid compressor combining LZ77 lazy matching with a 5-stream rANS entropy coder and a per-block dictionary codec. v4.9 ships with an entropy gatekeeper (random.bin compresses 76% faster), local sub-dict selection (mixed.bin 30% better ratio), and a calibrated v4 cost model. Aggregate ratio 3.15× across the 8-file bench corpus, 74% of zstd.
